title: Duty Line Alert: CFO Denies Approvals, $2.25M Out

fields.sender: Tamarack Precision Components — Security Duty Officer
fields.headline: SECURITY DUTY ALERT — SUSPECTED EXECUTIVE IMPERSONATION, WIRES RELEASED
fields.body: Duty officer to CISO, cc General Counsel. Confirmed: real CFO reached on his directory number. He approved nothing. WIRE-0914-001/-002/-003, total $2,250,000, released 10:55, 11:40 and 13:15 to Escrow Fiduciaria Bajío SA. WIRE-0914-004 $390,000 now on HOLD. Both 'executives' in the 10:05 meeting joined as external guests from 203.0.113.84.
fields.areaAffected: Treasury and Finance — Greenville HQ; Treasury Workstation; meeting platform
instructions: RISK: Treasury Analyst has asked IT whether she can 'clear the meeting chat so it doesn't spread.' IT has not acted yet.
RISK: The recording of meeting 'Project escrow – confidential' is owned by the external organizer. Retention is organizer-controlled, so it can be deleted at any time.
RISK: GC's assistant forwarded a 13:48 email 'from Priscilla Aranguren' asking Treasury to 'proceed with the final tranche.' Priscilla Aranguren says she sent no such email.
DECISION: Do you want me to open the incident under TPC-SEC-02? Bridge 864-555-0100, code 4417, can be up on your word. Reply or call the duty line.

instructorNote: This alert pulls the confirmed facts together and pushes the CISO to declare a combined fraud and synthetic-media incident at about 14:12 under TPC-SEC-02. Watch for an explicit no-deletion order covering the chat, recording, invite, lookalike chat, 13:48 email and Workstation audit log. Also check that the General Counsel issues a legal hold, starts the IC3, insurer and Audit Committee clocks, and that the bank fraud desk call follows next.
